propositions: Auto-deploy restarts review-bot container mid-review causing in-flight reviews to timeout and fail-close with LLM-Review -1 vote, which blocks the backfill reconciler's automatic recovery
Current shutdown drain timeout of 45 seconds is insufficient for review completion (max observed 911 seconds), causing premature worker cancellation during deployment
Retryable failure conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, git-fetch timeout) should defer voting and remain unvoted to allow reconciler backfill re-drive instead of fail-closing
Terminal failure conditions (indeterminate, finding, gate-disabled) must still cast fail-closed -1 votes to signal definitive outcomes
Bounded escalation protocol: after N consecutive retryable failures on same revision, cast fail-closed -1 with exhausted note and emit VOTER_ERROR for operator alerting
Drain quiesce must size shutdown_grace_period to cover full review timeout (1200s) plus store-write and lock buffers, matching zero-downtime deployment patterns
